title: Domino and Tromino Tiling

story.title: Tiling the Barn Floor
story.text: A 2-wide barn floor is tiled with dominoes and L-shaped trominoes. The farmer chalks how many ways each length can be tiled: dp[i] = 2·dp[i-1] + dp[i-3].
story.goal: Return the number of tilings of a 2 x n floor, modulo 1e9+7.
